instructor: Olumlu yönü yok. Saygısız, vasıfsız, kompleksli, zavallı biri. Bilkent eğitim kadrosu içinde açık ara en kötüsü olduğuna inanıyorum. Sadece Bilkent'te değil, genel olarak nasıl hala bir işi olabilir anlamıyorum. Hangi dersi verdiği önemli değil, uzak durulması gereken biri. Ben bir hata yaptım, siz yapmayın.
Weak points:
He can have trouble navigating the online system and forget what he's doing mid-class.

He spends 30-50 minutes of total lecture time per week (out of 150) analyzing previous homework assignments and quizzes. Coupled with the increased time between switching from one presentation to the other, we either end up not covering enough material during the class or only getting an introduction and don't understand the material. We may as well skip class at this point.

He too often ignores our questions during class.

Strong points:
He always makes sure to give everyone the necessary feedback with regards to all assignments, which makes sure that we don't finish the chapter without learning the topic.

He makes great effort to adapt to the students' needs with purposeful breaks, lecture outlines and such.

General feedback:

Overall, the course wasn't a good experience.
The time spent on the feedback given on the homework assignments/quizzes should be greatly decreased - as in my and many of my friends' experience the solutions given in moodle and the feedback in the emails are almost always enough for us.
The extra time left from not giving feedback for half the class should be spent on covering the topics BOTH slower AND in greater detail, because we struggle to understand what the topic is about, and the learning process always takes place while solving the homework assignments, and is often too confusing.
The structure of the lectures (as it relates to the online-delivery) can be improved upon with prosthetic accommodations, reinforcing the general idea of what will be covered during the lecture and utilizing methods for switching the shared-screen focus from one presentation to the other faster, as well as using moodle for uploading short video-solutions for the assignments (this really can make things faster for both of us).
Strongest: course is designed in such a way that you dont even need to study for the finals.
